description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeEmployeeAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to purge (delete) employee data in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for handling HTTP DELETE requests to purge an employee based on an employee number, along with validation rules and dependency management.
